import ctypes

# Load the necessary libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the custom error handler function
@ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(None, ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int)
def custom_error_handler(reason, file, line, gsl_errno):
    print(f'Custom Error Handler Invoked: {reason.decode()} in {file.decode()} at line {line}, error code {gsl_errno}')

# Set the custom error handler
previous_handler = gsl.gsl_set_error_handler(custom_error_handler)

# Define the assert_test function

def assert_test():
    # Test setting the custom error handler
    assert previous_handler is not None, 'Previous handler should not be None'

    # Test invoking the error handler
    gsl.gsl_error(b'Test error', b'test_file.c', 42, 1)

    # Test setting the error handler off
    previous_handler_off = gsl.gsl_set_error_handler_off()
    assert previous_handler_off is not None, 'Previous handler off should not be None'

if __name__ == '__main__':
    assert_test()
